                                    Each PAT is scoped to the repos that use it. Repos with no PAT assigned use the first matching token.
                                    

                                        

                                            🔑 The token needs Read and write access to code
                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                1
                                                Open Create GitHub PAT ↗
                                            

                                            

                                                2
                                                Set the token's access to Permissions → Contents → Read and write (read/write access to your code), and pick the repos to grant under Repository access.
                                            

                                            

                                                3
                                                Copy the generated token and paste it into 0GIT (＋ Add PAT → token field → Save Token).
                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            GitLab: create a token with the api scope (or read_repository + write_repository).
